gates.G1_runner: Rows 1 and 6 are my own example.com brackets. If either is not ok/200, or the relay's own control row is not ok, the batch is VOID as to every content row.
gates.G2_no_cross_host: No row's outcome may be read as evidence about any host other than its own.
gates.G5_status_is_not_source_state: Cardinal. A refused/403, a 404, or a find_matched:false is a statement about this client's access or about a string in a rendering. NONE of them may be restated as a fact about the case, the award, or the proceeding. In particular: nothing in this batch may found a claim that an award has or has not issued.

decision_rules.E1: UNIT: row 2 (percent-encoded URL, bare, no find). IDENTITY ROW. An empty find returns body[:400] (scripts/fetch_relay.py:136), which identifies the page for free — the technique adopted on 2026-08-04. If ok/200 AND the window identifies an ICSID case-detail page for UNCT/20/6, the route is open and rows 3 and 4 are interpretable. If the window identifies a search form, an error page, or a different case, rows 3 and 4 are VOID as to this docket and the route is NOT established. SCOPE: E1 governs whether rows 3 and 4 may be read at all.
decision_rules.E2: UNIT: row 3 (find 'Latest Development'). If matched, the 400-character window centred on that field is the evidence — and ONLY the window's own text may be read. A window is not a docket. If the window carries a dated entry, that date is carried by the administering institution's own page, which is a materially better provenance than every Einarsson date now in the record, all of which are index- or title-carried. If NOT matched, the recorded fact is that the string was absent from that rendering at that instant; per the registered risk that most likely means the UNCT-series field names differ, and row 2's window is then the thing to read.
decision_rules.E3: UNIT: row 4 (find 'Status of Proceeding'). Independent second question, deliberately a separate row rather than bundled, because a find-miss suppresses the excerpt entirely and bundling makes it impossible to learn which string matched.
decision_rules.E4: UNIT: row 5 (UNENCODED slashes in the query value, bare) against row 2 (percent-encoded). URL-FORM PARITY CHECK, instrument-only. The search result carried the encoded form; the analyst's proposed row used the unencoded form. If both return ok/200 with equal bytes and equal sha256, the two forms reach the same resource and future batches may use either. If they differ in outcome, the encoded form is canonical for this host and the record should say so. SCOPE: E4 is a finding about URL handling, never about the case.
decision_rules.E5: NOT ASSERTED IN ADVANCE: no row here may found an ordinal, a count, a 'first', a 'never', or any claim about the existence, timing or content of an award. The record's existing Einarsson posture — post-merits-hearing March 2025, awaiting award — is NOT amended by any row in this batch unless the window's own text states otherwise.
